title: API: a Create & Edit role without Delete can create an untracked part through the API (D14, by design)
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (b) "QA PL Create&Edit" (Part Library & Inventory View + Create & Edit, Delete unticked). API replay from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location (Copy as fetch from a request of the logged-in session, then edit method, path and body). Category = the category of QAPL-T1. D14 is by design: the API accepting this is expected, do not file it.
custom_steps:
1. Open /parts/inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Fill Description, Part Number QA-D14-TR-1 and Category, keep the default bin and Save; copy the POST /api/inventory/parts/create request from the Network tab.
  3. Replay it as (b) with <cat> = the categoryId from that request and the body {"partNumber":"QA-D14-UN-1","description":"QA loose bolts","categoryId":"<cat>","vendorId":null,"manufacturerId":null,"quantity":0,"cost":"1.50","sellPrice":null,"min":null,"max":null,"gridLocation":null,"coreCharge":null,"environmentalCharge":null,"tags":[],"bins":[],"isFixedPrice":false,"isTracked":false}.
  4. GET /api/inventory/parts?search=QA-D14-UN-1.
  5. Reload /parts/inventory and search QA-D14.
custom_expected:
1. The dialog opens; the Track quantities and cost of goods switch (toggle_track_quantities) is on and disabled.
  2. 201 with "isTracked":true; the tracked part saves.
  3. 201 with "isTracked":false (accepted by design, D14).
  4. 200; the part is listed with is_tracked: false.
  5. QA-D14-UN-1 shows Not Tracked in Total Qty; QA-D14-TR-1 shows its available quantity.
